description: Builds a price alert (above / below a price, or rise / fall by a percentage within a time window, optionally with more conditions such as RSI 14 below 30 or price above EMA 200) and replays it without saving anything: how often it would have fired.

channels.description: Where alerts go; default: the first channel set up in the app (Telegram, then push, then email).

coins.description: rise/fall only: watch several coins as one scanner.

items.description: Trading pair with a slash, such as BTC/USDT or ETH/EUR.

conditions.description: More conditions, all joined with AND, like “Add condition” in the app: up to 3 next to the price condition, 4 without it. Example: [{"subject": "rsi14", "operator": "below", "value": 30}, {"subject": "price", "operator": "above", "target": "ema200"}].

operator.description: below / above: as long as it holds; crossesAbove / crossesBelow: only at the candle where it happens. Volume only below or above.

subject.description: What is compared: price, a moving average (ema9 … ema200, sma20 … sma200), RSI (rsi7, rsi14, rsi21), stoch (stochastic 14 · 3 · 3), macd (12 · 26 · 9) or volume.

target.description: For price and moving averages: the line to compare with (price, a moving average, or the Bollinger bands 20 · 2 as bbUpper, bbMiddle, bbLower). For macd: signal or zero.

value.description: For RSI and stoch: the threshold, 0 to 100. For volume: the multiple of its 20-candle average, such as 2.

days.description: How many days the replay looks back; default 90, at most replayDays from get_account.

exchange.description: Exchange ID as offered in the candle settings (get_template → parameters, setting "exchange"); default: the template’s or the app’s default.

kind.description: above: the price reaches or rises above value; below: reaches or falls below value; rise / fall: changes by value percent within window. Required unless priceCondition is false.

name.description: Own name for the chain; default like "BTC/USDT below 60,000 $".

once.description: Pause after the first alert; default true for above/below, false for rise/fall.

pair.description: Trading pair such as BTC/USDT; required unless coins or top is given.

priceCondition.description: false leaves out the price condition (kind, value, window), so only the conditions count. Default true.

timeframe.description: Candles for the conditions, only together with them; default 1h, for rise/fall the longest candles up to 1h that fit into window. window must be a whole number of these candles.

top.description: rise/fall only: the top N coins by volume against this quote currency, renewed daily.

trade.description: Take-profit and stop-loss for scoring the signals as trades: entry at the close of the alert candle, a candle reaching both counts as SL, every signal on its own. Default: the chain’s or template’s values (meta.trade), otherwise TP and SL 2 : 1 fitting the timeframe, such as 3 % and 1.5 % on hourly candles.

breakEven.description: With stages: after the first TP stage the SL moves to the entry.

fee.description: Fee per side in percent, default 0.1.

maxBars.description: Exit at the close of this many candles after the entry if neither TP nor SL came by then.

positions.description: Signals while a trade is still open: each counts as its own trade (each, default), they are skipped (one: one trade at a time), or a signal in the other direction closes the open trade at its close and opens the new one (flip).

side.description: long profits when the price rises, short when it falls.

stages.description: Up to two more TP stages after takeProfit (TP2, TP3), each further away; every stage closes an equal part of the trade.

stopLoss.description: Stop-loss (SL) in percent from the entry, such as 1.5; with unit "atr" as a multiple of the ATR.

takeProfit.description: Take-profit (TP) in percent from the entry, such as 3; with unit "atr" as a multiple of the ATR, such as 2.

trailing.description: Trailing stop: the SL follows the best price since the entry at the stopLoss distance.

unit.description: percent (default) or atr: TP and SL as multiples of the ATR 14 at the alert candle.

value.description: Price in the quote currency for above/below, percent (up to 1000) for rise/fall. Required unless priceCondition is false.
